_doc: Global plugin settings for context-engineering-kit. Edit here to control behaviour across all projects.
_notes: auto_activate_new_repos: when true, SessionStart bootstraps any project that has no session_handover.md
features.*: disable individual features without removing hook wiring
skip_repos: list of absolute project paths to never auto-init (e.g. /home/user/sensitive-repo)
morning_brief is off by default — enable it after running: pip install feedparser
